subject: PRV4
title: Restitution
description: The law relating to the restitution of benefits wrongfully or unfairly acquired: a study of unjust enrichment as a doctrinal basis for various remedies at common law, in equity and under statute and the role of unjust enrichment as an integral part of the common law alongside contract and tort.This course provides an opportunity for immersion in the culture, epistemology and practices of the Common Law Tradition.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken PRV4 435.

subject: PRV4
title: Land Use Planning
description: A study of private and public control of land use and development, including: constitutional jurisdiction; provincial, regional and local planning; regulatory and discretionary tools (e.g., zoning by-laws, subdivision control, site-plan control), acquired rights; expropriation, land values and compensation, protection of sensitive areas (e.g. heritage property, agricultural land).

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken PRV4 145

subject: PRV4
title: Administration Property of Another and Trusts
description: The civil law that applies to trusts and administration of the property of another. Includes liquidation of successions, tutorship to a minor or to a person of full age and protection mandate./Le droit civil applicable à la fiducie et à l’administration du bien d’autrui. La liquidation d’une succession, la tutelle au mineur ou au majeur inapte et le mandat de protection sont également abordés.

subject: PRV4
title: Equity and Trusts
description: A consideration of the law of gratuitous transfers, concentrating on the express trust: the nature of the trust, the creation and conditions of validity of the trust, effect of failure, obligations and interests arising under the trust, variation, renovation, and termination of the trust. Related topics such as gifts, wills, intestate succession, powers of appointment and the rule against perpetuities may also be discussed.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken PRV4 449 or PRV4 449D1/D2
